latestVersion.changelog:
Founder Coach v0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Launches an AI-powered mindset coach for startup founders, focused on upgrading thinking patterns and applying proven mental models.
- Detects and gently intervenes in low-level thinking patterns using Socratic questioning.
- Supports weekly challenges and progress reports, tracked in an append-only founder profile.
- Integrates optionally with PhoenixClaw for enhanced journal insights (read-only).
- Covers core mental models: Product-Market Fit, 4Ps, and selected NFX frameworks.
- Implements strong guardrails: no business advice, no team/collab features, no visualizations, no non-English support in v1.
